title: Almost nobody who flies private owns the plane
description: Owning a jet only pays off above a flight-hour threshold that almost no private flyer reaches. So the people stepping onto the airstair are not buying an aircraft. They are buying hours.

scenes.narration: Almost nobody who flies private actually owns the plane.
scenes.imagePrompt: A private jet silhouetted on a dark wet runway apron at night, airstair lowered, runway lights streaking behind it, plain unmarked white fuselage, no people

scenes.narration: A large jet costs sixty million dollars to buy, before it has flown a single mile.
scenes.imagePrompt: Low three-quarter view of the nose and dark cockpit windows of a private jet inside a dim hangar, polished white paint falling away into deep shadow, single hard light raking from the side, plain unmarked fuselage, no people

scenes.narration: Owning one only makes financial sense above about two hundred flight hours a year.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single private jet parked alone inside a vast dark hangar, one work lamp glowing on the concrete floor, deep shadow filling the space, plain unmarked fuselage, no people

scenes.narration: The typical private flyer uses about fifty hours a year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Empty private jet cabin interior, cream leather club seats facing each other across polished wood tables, small oval windows, warm low lighting, no people

scenes.narration: So they buy hours instead: a fractional share, or a card of prepaid flight time.
scenes.imagePrompt: Row of oval private jet windows seen from outside at dusk, warm cabin glow spilling out of each one, polished white fuselage, plain unmarked paint, shallow focus

scenes.narration: Chartering that same aircraft runs around ten thousand dollars an hour, all in.
scenes.imagePrompt: Macro of a private jet engine nacelle and fan blades half in shadow, brushed metal and smooth cowling, single hard light source, plain unmarked casing

scenes.narration: Fifty hours of that is half a million a year, against sixty million and a full-time crew.
scenes.imagePrompt: Aerial view of a single private jet parked on a remote runway at dawn, long shadow stretching across empty tarmac, flat empty landscape all around, no people

scenes.narration: So the jet sitting on the tarmac is almost never theirs. The access is.
scenes.imagePrompt: A private jet taxiing away down a dark runway seen from behind, tail silhouette against distant city lights, wet reflective asphalt, plain unmarked surfaces, no people
